title: Indexed Boolean list block
statement: For natural numbers $n,m,j$ and a Boolean list $r$, define the $j$th raw block to be the list obtained by first removing the initial $n(m+4)$ entries of $r$, then removing the next $j\,2(m+12)$ entries, and taking up to $2(m+12)$ entries from what remains.
